en.headline: Festival Walk opens Pokémon 30th anniversary event with first Hong Kong Pokémon Center pop-up
en.dek: The free celebration runs from 11 November to 3 January at the Kowloon Tong mall, featuring installations, a time tunnel and the first official Pokémon Center pop-up store in the city.
body: Festival Walk launched its Pokémon 30 Years of Joy event on Wednesday, running until 3 January 2027 across levels LG2 and G at the Kowloon Tong mall.

The free event includes a giant sprinting Pikachu balloon installation, a 10-metre Poké Ball-themed lighting decoration, character photo spots featuring Pikachu, Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle and Gengar, and a Pokémon Time Tunnel. Hong Kong’s first official Pokémon Center pop-up store is also open, offering exclusive merchandise.

Organisers said the pop-up store requires advance booking via the GULU app for the initial period, with walk-ins accepted later. My Festival members who spend at least HK$3,800 on the same day with designated electronic payments can redeem a special anniversary logo rug while stocks last, at the LG2 customer service centre from noon to 9pm.

zh.headline: 又一城Pokémon 30周年活動開幕 全港首個Pokémon Center Pop-Up登場
zh.dek: 免費活動由11月11日至明年1月3日在九龍塘又一城舉行，設巨型裝置、時光隧道及全港首個官方Pokémon Center限時店。
body: 又一城周三展開《Pokémon’s 30 Years of Joy at Festival Walk》活動，至2027年1月3日於九龍塘商場LG2及G層舉行。
免費活動包括巨型衝刺比卡超氣球裝置、10米高精靈球主題燈光裝飾、比卡超、妙蛙種子、小火龍、傑尼龜及耿鬼打卡位，以及Pokémon時光隧道。全港首個官方Pokémon Center限時店亦同步開幕，提供獨家商品。
主辦方表示，限時店初期需透過GULU應用程式事先預約，其後接受即場排隊。My Festival會員即日以指定電子支付消費滿3800元，可於中午至晚上9時到LG2層顧客服務處換領特別版周年標誌地毯，先到先得，換完即止。
